shots.intent: 搜索列表第一眼，梦幻氛围中一眼锁定产品
放大日常护肤不彻底、毛孔与持久度困扰，建立需求
一秒传达核心护理利益，机身与卖点卡同框
用编号卡片讲清功能结构，消除看不懂的疑虑
让买家代入居家护理瞬间，呈现轻柔使用感

以留白凭证框与机身同框降低购买疑虑

套餐与赠品氛围收口促单，优惠信息后置合成

style.backgroundSystem: cloud lavender #CFC7EF to blush pink #F6CFE0 dreamy gradients for hero and scene shots, pearl white #FFFFFF rounded cards for infographic and pain screens
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single soft violet-blue accent on rounded cards
style.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused glow light, gentle front key with halo bloom, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dreamy pastel beauty-device ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud lavender #CFC7EF, blush pink #F6CFE0, pearl white #FFFFFF and one rose-gold metallic accent #C9988A; bright soft diffused glow lighting with gentle halo bloom and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style on soft rounded cards; clean high-end beauty device photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale for the handheld device; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the handheld device across the set, device always upright or naturally tilted
style.surfaceSystem: matte pearl-white device shell with brushed rose-gold #C9988A metallic head accents, soft matte pastel backdrop
